Market today: Mixed signals. China's bank issues could spook global markets, pushing risk-off. But Sam Altman's comment on Cerebras is a positive for chip sentiment. Rising bond yields remain a key headwind for growth/tech.

Your holdings: SOXL (-27.16%) and SPAL (-24.89%) are your biggest concerns. Both are leveraged ETFs, meaning they decay and drops are amplified, especially on margin.

Watch: Keep an eye on bond yields; continued rises will pressure your tech/chip names. Also, watch for any further news on China's financial stability.

Bottom line: Manage your leveraged losers aggressively while keeping an eye on macro headwinds.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or cutting losses on this leveraged ETF, currently down -27.16%, to reduce margin exposure.
SPAL: Evaluate trimming or cutting losses on this leveraged ETF, down -24.89%, to mitigate further drawdown risk.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
